content:
**Oak Holler Lager** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A frothy light-colored beer brewed using Thistles and Razorgrain. It increases Strength and Charisma by one while also lowering Intelligence by one.

Similar to other fermentable pre-War beverages, Oak Holler Lager is initially crafted as fermentable Oak Holler Lager, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads, and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented. It shares its appearance with a standard beer bottle but has an Oak Holler label featuring two chuckling, bearded men.

Oak Holler Lager can be crafted using a Brewing Station with the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*.
